8.text: for the bears. When he tried to defend himself, the female “spirit” reminded

10.text: which was directed against a bear sleeping in its den. From the old Chukchee

11.text: point of view, this certainly was a rather dangerous pursuit.¹ In the end

12.text: the “spirit” said that the man in question, because of his offences against

17.text: That, probably, would appease those “walking afoot.”

22.text: attacked his herd, and killed nine fat bucks. To check the recurrence of

23.text: such a misfortune, it is necessary to take a small crotch of willow³ cut on

24.text: the place of the attack by wolves, and perform over it the required ceremonial.
